content: Food insecurity, which is defined as having inconsistent access to nutritious food, impacts approximately 16% of adults living with diabetes. It is essential to implement screening for food insecurity at all levels of healthcare to identify individuals who may be at risk and to connect them with appropriate resources and support systems. Screening typically involves asking specific questions, such as whether a household runs out of food before they are able to obtain more, to evaluate the level of risk for food insecurity.
